budget.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

manifest.failure_policy: preserve sample failure and continue unless provider unavailable or request cap

first_pass_gate.name: first_pass_facts
first_pass_gate.definition: the first-role HANDOFF line emitted before any remedy call carries every literal of the frozen handle_facts list of its task under the frozen semantic judge, is single-line and within the 450-character contract
first_pass_gate.saving_requires: tool-sequence consistency, strict and semantic quality non-inferior to the uncompressed arm, first-pass completeness recorded, and complete total tokens positive

tool_sequence_gate.name: tool_sequence_consistent
tool_sequence_gate.definition: the first role's recorded tool trace equals the frozen task's tool list for that role, in the frozen order, once per tool; tool_sequence_matches_baseline additionally requires equality with the uncompressed arm's recorded trace for the same task and repeat
tool_sequence_gate.acceptance: plugin tool-sequence consistency and strict/semantic quality must not be worse than the uncompressed arm, and complete total tokens must be positive

failure_class_gate.name: failure_class
failure_class_gate.definition: tool_sequence = the first role's trace is not the frozen tool list; contract_placeholder_echo = the tool sequence is consistent but the delivered answer still contains the contract's angle brackets or its labelled decision field is not the frozen decision word; none = both quality gates passed; other = anything else
failure_class_gate.precedence: tool_sequence first, then success, then the contract axis
failure_class_gate.audited: the independent audit re-derives the class from the recorded row and rejects a mismatch, so samples cannot be re-classified after the run

mechanism_rules.how: the newest K protected tool-group placeholders of the prepared (pre-compression) list are re-appended verbatim when the compressed view dropped them, so the adapter restores the real tool messages byte-for-byte; no host instruction message is added anywhere
mechanism_rules.omissions: with K=3 nothing is left compressible for the first role's three frozen rounds; every omission and every compression event is still counted
mechanism_rules.contract_wording: the deciding role receives the frozen r8 contract sentence plus one pre-registered sentence requiring the angle-bracket placeholder to be replaced by the actual tool-evidence value and the angle brackets themselves never to be output
mechanism_rules.removed_after_r11: no directive message: r11's tool-sequence directive was self-maintaining and looped the first role on one tool in 12/16 samples

outcomes.boundary_nothing_left_to_compress: tool sequence perfect, quality back at the frozen threshold, and no tool round left compressible -- on this host, keeping every round the first role needs costs the whole saving
outcomes.compression_exonerated_residual_is_model: tool sequence perfect but quality still short, failures concentrated in contract_placeholder_echo -- compression is exonerated on the tool-sequence axis and the residual is a model/contract-wording defect
outcomes.tool_sequence_not_caused_by_compression: the tool sequence is still short of the uncompressed arm -- the missing tool rounds are not a compression artefact
